info.title: Account activity counters
info.description: Existing account-owned counter reads, absolute refreshes and delta operations. Preserve REAL/DEMO and job group context. Event-document refresh maps existing source IDs locally; feedback transition sends only owner/creator/admin identifiers and the four transition flags. Bounded 4096-ID inputs / 2 MiB; no automatic retry. Delta write acknowledgment recovery and event eligibility coordination remain explicit workflow gaps.

post.description: Applies each account counter delta and its immutable command receipt in one document update. An identical receipt replay is a no-op; no HTTP automatic retry is enabled.

serviceCapability.description: Dedicated server-only activity counter command capability.
